reviewer: phase1-independent-review / independent Codex research reviewer / local macOS
scope: Combined bounded Phase1 discovery readiness; no semantic reconciliation, portfolio selection, publication or implementation approval.

stream_preservation.permitted_delta: Only optional research_depth in candidate records; all other reviewed stream bytes unchanged.

query_receipt.result_reproduction: Exact parsed JSON equality after removing receipt wrapper
query_receipt.digest_recipe: Sort all candidate/assertion/evidence $records/*.json plus evidence/demo-demand-coverage.json and query_index.py by Path; SHA256 concat(relative-to-research-base UTF8 path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL) for each. Excludes generated result, schemas, gates, questions, tests and reports.

meaning_datasets.limitation: Exact IDs only; no equivalence inferred between canonical requests and provisional IDs.

alpha2_datasets.limitation: Literal candidate representations only; assertion-only or differently named ISO fields are explicitly outside query scope; conceptual matches imply no dataset.

four_plus_demos.limitation: Structural and observed nonnull evidence remain separate; no cross-demo identity inference.

demo_enrichments.limitation: Proposed relevance, not verified join success or selected integrations.

scenario_dependents.limitation: Both members and dependencies traversed with cycle protection; conceptual bundles not executable joins.

licensing_rejections.limitation: Recorded blocked/rejected decisions; needs-review rights remain in source records.

freshness_revalidation.limitation: Groups overlap; effective-value origin shown; inspection time not upstream release, missing schedules not clearance.

promising_shallow.limitation: Unknown/missing and all shallow also returned; lifecycle does not imply depth.

meaning_dataset_gaps.limitation: Suitability undetermined; no explicit link does not mean no suitable dataset exists.

unreconciled_dataset_mappings.limitation: 41 non-demo dataset candidates include rejected TPC-H; no mapping, unresolved and accepted-receipt-backed branches distinct.

boundaries.phase1_gate: pending until root acceptance and independently reviewed gate/receipt delta
